title: Font inspector
idea: Font inspector: Real text specimens expose glyph coverage and metrics
audience: People who need to inspect font within a desktop surface.
worksWellWhen: Typography decisions depend on actual content
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic craft layout through its inspect font priority and explicit commitment contract: Installed face availability must be measured rather than assumed
navigation: Font inspector keeps the current inspect font context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Real text specimens expose glyph coverage and metrics
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect font; typography decisions depend on actual content
composition.priority: Installed face availability must be measured rather than assumed

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect font context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Test script fallback and enlarged labels in the specimen
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the font inspector structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect font content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Installed face availability must be measured rather than assumed
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect font content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Installed face availability must be measured rather than assumed
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect font context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
